name: Half-time heavy acid
desc: Slow, sludgy half-time acid in Bb minor on a 24db saw: whole-bar i-i-VI-VII root progression, counter-phase sine/cosine filter and envelope sweeps over 16-32 cycles, half-note gain pump, ply doubles as phrase-end fills. Heavy and menacing rather than busy.

code.full: note("<bb1 bb1 gb1 ab1> [~ <bb1 bb1 gb1 ab1>] ~ [<bb2 bb2 gb2 ab2> ~]").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype('24db').lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).attack(.01).decay(.3).sustain(.4).release(.15).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.35, ${cut}*1.5).slow(32)).lpenv(cosine.range(1, 5).slow(16)).lpa(.008).lpd(.2).lpq(sine.range(4, 10).slow(48)).shape(${drive}).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.6, ${gain}).fast(2)).room(.12).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("[<bb1 bb1 gb1 ab1> <bb1 bb1 gb1 ab1> <bb2 bb2 gb2 ab2> <bb1 bb1 gb1 ab1>]*2").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype('24db').lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).attack(.005).decay(.22).sustain(.3).release(.1).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.5, ${cut}*2).slow(16)).lpenv(cosine.range(2, 6).slow(8)).lpa(.005).lpd(.15).lpq(sine.range(6, 12).slow(24)).shape(${drive}).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.55, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
